tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Current bid/ask and daily % change for forex majors/minors, gold, silver, oil and crypto.

tools.name: get_economic_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming (and optionally recent) macro events with impact, forecast, previous and actual values. Times are UTC.

tools.name: get_screener
tools.description: Per-symbol technicals: TradingView recommendation per timeframe (M15/H1/H4/D1, -1 strong sell … +1 strong buy), RSI, ADX, MACD, Bollinger position, stochastic state and ATR.

tools.name: get_currency_strength
tools.description: Relative strength of the 8 major currencies, derived from today's % change across available pairs. Sorted strongest first.

tools.name: get_market_sessions
tools.description: Whether the forex market is open, active sessions (Sydney/Tokyo/London/New York), current and upcoming overlaps.

tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.description: Lot size so that hitting the stop loss loses `riskPct` % of the balance. Account currency is assumed to be USD.
